text: 二人同心，其利断金
pinyin: èr rén tóng xīn, qí lì duàn jīn
literal: two · people · same · heart, their · sharpness · cut · metal
natural: When two people share one heart, their sharpness can cut through metal

meaning.en: United people are strong enough to overcome any obstacle; quoted for teamwork, friendship and marriage.
meaning.zh: 同心协力，力量足以克服任何困难，常用于赞美团队、友情与夫妻同心。

examples.zh: 夫妻创业，“二人同心，其利断金”，终于闯出一片天。
examples.en: The couple started a business: '二人同心，其利断金', and finally made their mark.

examples.zh: 队长鼓励大家“二人同心，其利断金”。
examples.en: The captain urged everyone: '二人同心，其利断金'.

story.en: From the Appendix to the Book of Changes: 'When two people are of one mind, their sharpness cuts through metal; words of one mind are fragrant as orchids' (二人同心，其利断金；同心之言，其臭如兰).
story.zh: 出自《周易·系辞上》：“二人同心，其利断金；同心之言，其臭如兰。”

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 所谓伊人，在水一方
pinyin: suǒ wèi yī rén, zài shuǐ yī fāng
literal: the · so-called · that person, at · water · one · side
natural: The one I speak of is on the other side of the water

meaning.en: A beloved who is near yet out of reach; quoted for longing and for an ideal that cannot be attained.
meaning.zh: 心中思慕的人近在眼前却难以接近，常用来表达思慕与追求不得。

examples.zh: “所谓伊人，在水一方”，那种可望而不可即的感觉让他着迷。
examples.en: '所谓伊人，在水一方': the feeling of something visible yet unreachable fascinated him.

examples.zh: 歌词写着“所谓伊人，在水一方”。
examples.en: The lyrics say '所谓伊人，在水一方'.

story.en: A poem in the Book of Songs (Qin odes), 'Reeds', where the speaker follows the beloved along the river but never reaches them.
story.zh: 《诗经·秦风·蒹葭》，抒写追寻水边伊人而不得的怅惘。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 亦余心之所善兮，虽九死其犹未悔
pinyin: yì yú xīn zhī suǒ shàn xī, suī jiǔ sǐ qí yóu wèi huǐ
literal: also · my · heart · [of] · what · cherish · [particle], though · nine · deaths · I · still · not yet · regret
natural: It is what my heart holds dear, and though I die nine deaths I will not regret it

meaning.en: Unshakeable devotion to one's ideals even at the cost of life; quoted to express steadfast conviction.
meaning.zh: 为理想坚持到底，纵然多次濒死也无悔，常用来表达坚定的信念。

equivalents: I would die for my ideals and never regret it

examples.zh: 科学家用“亦余心之所善兮，虽九死其犹未悔”形容自己的追求。
examples.en: The scientist used '亦余心之所善兮，虽九死其犹未悔' to describe his pursuit.

examples.zh: 他把“亦余心之所善兮，虽九死其犹未悔”刻在书桌上。
examples.en: He carved '亦余心之所善兮，虽九死其犹未悔' on his desk.

story.en: From Qu Yuan's 'Encountering Sorrow', written after he fell out of favour in the court of Chu.
story.zh: 出自屈原《离骚》，抒发遭谗被疏后坚守理想的志节。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 长太息以掩涕兮，哀民生之多艰
pinyin: cháng tài xī yǐ yǎn tì xī, āi mín shēng zhī duō jiān
literal: long · sigh · to · cover · tears · [particle], grieve · people's · lives · [of] · many · hardships
natural: I sigh long, wiping away tears, grieving that the people's lives are so full of hardship

meaning.en: Compassion for the suffering of ordinary people; quoted to express concern for the people.
meaning.zh: 对百姓苦难的深切同情，常用来表达忧国忧民之情。

equivalents: to sigh over the people's hardships

examples.zh: 他读到“长太息以掩涕兮，哀民生之多艰”，不禁红了眼眶。
examples.en: He read '长太息以掩涕兮，哀民生之多艰' and couldn't help his eyes reddening.

examples.zh: 作文里引用“长太息以掩涕兮，哀民生之多艰”，体现忧民情怀。
examples.en: Quoting '长太息以掩涕兮，哀民生之多艰' in the essay shows concern for the people.

story.en: In the Lisao, Qu Yuan laments the suffering of the people of Chu and the corrupt court.
story.zh: 《离骚》中屈原为楚国民生艰难和朝政昏暗而叹息。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 两岸青山相对出，孤帆一片日边来
pinyin: liǎng àn qīng shān xiāng duì chū, gū fān yī piàn rì biān lái
literal: two · banks · green · hills · facing each other · emerge, lone · sail · one · piece · sun · edge · come
natural: Green hills on both banks stand facing each other; a lone sail comes from the edge of the sun

meaning.en: A lively river scene as a boat sails out between mountains; quoted for dynamic landscape and the joy of travel.
meaning.zh: 描绘船行江上、两岸青山迎面而来的壮丽景象，常用来写旅行之乐。

equivalents: green hills greet the lone sail
the joy of a river journey

examples.zh: 坐船游长江，才懂“两岸青山相对出，孤帆一片日边来”的意境。
examples.en: Only after cruising the Yangtze did I understand the mood of '两岸青山相对出，孤帆一片日边来'.

examples.zh: 风景区门口刻着“两岸青山相对出，孤帆一片日边来”。
examples.en: '两岸青山相对出，孤帆一片日边来' is carved at the scenic area's entrance.

story.en: Li Bai wrote this quatrain around 725 when he sailed through the Tianmen Mountains on the Yangtze as a young man leaving Sichuan.
story.zh: 约725年李白初出蜀地，乘船过长江天门山时所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 天街小雨润如酥，草色遥看近却无
pinyin: tiān jiē xiǎo yǔ rùn rú sū, cǎo sè yáo kàn jìn què wú
literal: capital · street · light · rain · moist · like · cream, grass · colour · from afar · look · near · but · none
natural: Light rain on the capital streets, smooth as cream; from afar the grass is a haze of green, but close up it is nearly gone

meaning.en: A delicate picture of early spring, when green is faint and can only be seen from afar; quoted for early-spring scenery.
meaning.zh: 描写早春小雨滋润、远看青青近看却无的景象，常用于写早春。

equivalents: the faint green of early spring

examples.zh: 初春的清晨，“天街小雨润如酥，草色遥看近却无”，真美。
examples.en: On an early-spring morning, '天街小雨润如酥，草色遥看近却无', so lovely.

examples.zh: 作文描写春景时引用“天街小雨润如酥，草色遥看近却无”。
examples.en: The essay quotes '天街小雨润如酥，草色遥看近却无' in describing spring scenery.

origin.source: 韩愈《早春呈水部张十八员外》

story.en: A quatrain Han Yu sent to his friend Zhang Ji (Zhang the Eighteenth, an official in the Ministry of Works) in early spring.
story.zh: 韩愈早春寄赠水部员外郎张籍（排行十八）的诗。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随
pinyin: yè jīng yú qín, huāng yú xī, xíng chéng yú sī, huǐ yú suí
literal: work · excels · through · diligence, ruined · by · play; conduct · succeeds · through · thought, spoiled · by · going along
natural: Learning is perfected by diligence and ruined by idle play; conduct is achieved by thought and spoiled by going with the flow

meaning.en: Success comes from hard work and careful thinking; quoted as a school motto and as advice to students.
meaning.zh: 学业靠勤奋而精进，因嬉戏而荒废；德行靠思考而成就，因随便而败坏，常作校训和勉学之语。

examples.zh: 班级墙上贴着“业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随”。
examples.en: '业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随' is posted on the classroom wall.

examples.zh: 老师送给毕业生“业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随”。
examples.en: The teacher gave the graduates '业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随'.

story.en: From 'An Explanation to Encourage Learning', where Han Yu, as a university professor, urges students to study hard.
story.zh: 出自韩愈《进学解》，他任国子博士时勉励学生勤学。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 师者，所以传道受业解惑也
pinyin: shī zhě, suǒ yǐ chuán dào shòu yè jiě huò yě
literal: teacher · [topic], that by which · transmit · principles · impart · learning · resolve · doubts · [particle]
natural: A teacher is one who transmits the Way, imparts knowledge and resolves doubts

meaning.en: The classic definition of a teacher's role; quoted on Teachers' Day and in discussions of education.
meaning.zh: 对教师职责的经典概括，常在教师节和谈教育时引用。

equivalents: a teacher imparts the Way, teaches skills and dispels doubts

examples.zh: 教师节贺卡上写着“师者，所以传道受业解惑也”。
examples.en: The Teachers' Day card has '师者，所以传道受业解惑也' written on it.

examples.zh: 校长在讲话中说：“师者，所以传道受业解惑也”。
examples.en: The principal said in his speech: '师者，所以传道受业解惑也'.

story.en: From Han Yu's 'On Teachers', which defends the role of the teacher against the scorn of his time.
story.zh: 出自韩愈《师说》，针对当时耻于学师的风气而作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 闻道有先后，术业有专攻
pinyin: wén dào yǒu xiān hòu, shù yè yǒu zhuān gōng
literal: hear · the Way · has · before · after, skills · trades · have · specialise · study
natural: People learn the Way earlier or later, and each specialises in a different skill

meaning.en: Anyone can be a teacher in some area because knowledge and specialties differ; quoted to encourage learning from everyone.
meaning.zh: 谁先懂得道理有先后，各人专长不同，因此人人皆可为师，常用来鼓励虚心向人学习。

equivalents: everyone is a teacher in something

examples.zh: “闻道有先后，术业有专攻”，不要因为他年轻就不听他的意见。
examples.en: '闻道有先后，术业有专攻': don't ignore his view just because he's young.

examples.zh: 导师用“闻道有先后，术业有专攻”鼓励学生互相学习。
examples.en: The mentor used '闻道有先后，术业有专攻' to encourage students to learn from each other.

story.en: In 'On Teachers' Han Yu concludes that the student need not be inferior to the teacher, nor the teacher superior, since each has their own specialty.
story.zh: 《师说》中，韩愈认为弟子不必不如师，师不必贤于弟子，因各有所长。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 世有伯乐，然后有千里马
pinyin: shì yǒu bó lè, rán hòu yǒu qiān lǐ mǎ
literal: world · has · Bo Le, then · there is · thousand-li · horse
natural: Only when the world has a Bo Le can there be thousand-li horses

meaning.en: Talent needs someone with the eye to recognise it; quoted about managers and mentors spotting talent.
meaning.zh: 人才需要识才之人才能被发现，常用来谈领导者和导师发现人才的重要性。

equivalents: a good horse needs a good judge

examples.zh: “世有伯乐，然后有千里马”，没有慧眼的领导，再好的人才也被埋没。
examples.en: '世有伯乐，然后有千里马': without a discerning boss, even the best talent goes unnoticed.

examples.zh: 校长称自己是教育界的伯乐，正是“世有伯乐，然后有千里马”。
examples.en: The principal called himself the talent scout of education, just as '世有伯乐，然后有千里马'.

story.en: Han Yu's essay 'On Horses' uses horses and the legendary judge Bo Le as a metaphor for gifted people overlooked by rulers.
story.zh: 韩愈《马说》借千里马与伯乐，比喻贤才不遇明主。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭
pinyin: qiān shān niǎo fēi jué, wàn jìng rén zōng miè
literal: thousand · mountains · birds · flying · cease, ten-thousand · paths · human · traces · vanish
natural: On a thousand mountains, no birds fly; on ten thousand paths, no human tracks remain

meaning.en: A scene of absolute stillness and emptiness; quoted for loneliness and the stillness of winter.
meaning.zh: 一片万籁俱寂、人迹罕至的景象，常用来形容孤寂和冬日的静。

equivalents: a world gone silent and empty
not a bird, not a footprint

examples.zh: 大雪封山，真是“千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭”。
examples.en: The snow closed the mountain: truly '千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭'.

examples.zh: 画展里这幅雪景题为“千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭”。
examples.en: This snow scene in the exhibition is titled '千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭'.

story.en: Written during Liu Zongyuan's exile in Yongzhou, the poem presents a solitary fisherman in a frozen landscape.
story.zh: 柳宗元被贬永州时所作，写寒江雪景中独钓的渔翁。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪
pinyin: gū zhōu suō lì wēng, dú diào hán jiāng xuě
literal: lone · boat · straw-cloak · bamboo-hat · old man, alone · fish · cold · river · snow
natural: In a lone boat an old man in straw cloak and hat fishes alone in the cold river snow

meaning.en: A solitary figure unbothered by the surrounding world; quoted for loneliness, detachment and unyielding spirit.
meaning.zh: 孤独而超然的渔翁形象，常用来形容孤傲、淡泊的精神。

equivalents: a lone fisherman in the snow

examples.zh: 国画《孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪》笔墨简淡。
examples.en: The painting '孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪' is simple in its brushwork.

examples.zh: 他像“孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪”一样，守着自己的理想。
examples.en: He is like '孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪', holding to his ideals.

story.en: The closing lines of Liu Zongyuan's five-character quatrain; the fisherman is often read as the poet's own isolated self.
story.zh: 柳宗元五言绝句的结尾，渔翁常被视为诗人孤高自我的写照。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵
pinyin: shān bù zài gāo, yǒu xiān zé míng, shuǐ bù zài shēn, yǒu lóng zé líng
literal: mountain · not · depends on · height, has · immortal · then · famous; water · not · depends on · depth, has · dragon · then · numinous
natural: A mountain need not be high: if an immortal lives there it becomes famous; water need not be deep: if a dragon lives there it becomes divine

meaning.en: Worth lies in character, not outward size or grandeur; quoted to praise people or places of quality despite humble appearance.
meaning.zh: 价值在于德行而不在外在的高大，常用来赞美外表平凡但内涵出众的人或地方。

equivalents: it's quality, not size, that counts

examples.zh: 这家小店“山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵”，凭手艺赢得了口碑。
examples.en: This little shop '山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵': it won its reputation on craft.

examples.zh: “山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵”，学校不大，名师云集。
examples.en: '山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵': the school is small but full of famous teachers.

story.en: The opening of Liu Yuxi's 'Inscription for a Humble Room', composed while he was demoted to Hezhou.
story.zh: 刘禹锡贬谪和州时所作《陋室铭》的开头。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青
pinyin: tái hén shàng jiē lǜ, cǎo sè rù lián qīng
literal: moss · marks · climb · steps · green, grass · colour · enter · curtain · blue-green
natural: Moss creeps green up the steps; grass colours the curtain blue-green

meaning.en: A quiet picture of a humble home lived in contentedly; quoted for a tranquil, simple dwelling.
meaning.zh: 描写简朴居室的清幽景象，常用来形容恬淡自足的生活环境。

equivalents: moss on the steps, green through the curtains

examples.zh: 老屋虽旧，仍有“苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青”的雅趣。
examples.en: The old house is shabby, yet has the charm of '苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青'.

examples.zh: 语文课上老师讲解“苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青”的色彩美。
examples.en: The teacher explained the colour in '苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青' in class.

story.en: A description of the scholar's simple dwelling in the essay 'Inscription for a Humble Room'.
story.zh: 《陋室铭》中描写陋室环境的句子。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春
pinyin: chén zhōu cè pàn qiān fān guò, bìng shù qián tóu wàn mù chūn
literal: sunken · boat · side · bank · thousand · sails · pass, sick · tree · front · ten-thousand · trees · spring
natural: Beside the sunken boat a thousand sails pass; before the ailing tree ten thousand trees burst into spring

meaning.en: Setbacks of one person do not stop the world's progress; quoted to encourage optimism after failure.
meaning.zh: 个人的失败不会阻碍世界前进，新事物不断涌现，常用来在失意时鼓励乐观。

examples.zh: 下岗后他想起“沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春”，决定重新开始。
examples.en: After being laid off, he recalled '沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春' and decided to start afresh.

examples.zh: “沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春”，旧产业没落，新行业兴起。
examples.en: '沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春': old industries decline, new ones rise.

origin.source: 刘禹锡《酬乐天扬州初逢席上见赠》

story.en: Liu Yuxi answered Bai Juyi's poem when they met in Yangzhou in 826; after twenty-three years of exile he stayed optimistic.
story.zh: 826年刘禹锡与白居易在扬州相逢，酬答白诗；经二十三年贬谪仍乐观豁达。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝
pinyin: zì gǔ féng qiū bēi jì liáo, wǒ yán qiū rì shèng chūn zhāo
literal: since · antiquity · meet · autumn · grieve · desolation, I · say · autumn · days · surpass · spring · mornings
natural: Since ancient times people have grieved over the desolation of autumn; I say autumn days beat spring mornings

meaning.en: A positive take on autumn, against the poetic tradition of sad autumns; quoted to show an upbeat, unconventional outlook.
meaning.zh: 一反悲秋传统，赞美秋日胜过春朝，常用来表达乐观、不落俗套的心态。

examples.zh: 别人伤秋，他却“自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝”。
examples.en: Others lament autumn, but he says '自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝'.

examples.zh: 读到“自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝”，我对秋天有了新的看法。
examples.en: Reading '自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝' gave me a new view of autumn.

story.en: The first of two 'Autumn Verses' by Liu Yuxi, who stayed spirited despite long exile.
story.zh: 刘禹锡《秋词》二首之一，作者虽久经贬谪仍意气不衰。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 东边日出西边雨，道是无晴却有晴
pinyin: dōng biān rì chū xī biān yǔ, dào shì wú qíng què yǒu qíng
literal: east · side · sun · out · west · side · rain, say · is · no · clear sky · yet · has · clear sky
natural: Sun in the east, rain in the west; you'd say it isn't fair, yet it is (a pun on 晴 'clear' and 情 'feeling')

meaning.en: A pun: 晴 (fair weather) sounds like 情 (love). Quoted for ambiguous feelings or for mixed weather.
meaning.zh: “晴”与“情”谐音，既写天气，又暗含情意，常用来形容含蓄的情感或阴晴不定的天气。

equivalents: weather and feelings in the same breath
a hint of love hidden in the weather

examples.zh: “东边日出西边雨，道是无晴却有晴”，这话里分明有情意。
examples.en: '东边日出西边雨，道是无晴却有晴': there is clearly feeling in those words.

examples.zh: 傍晚忽雨忽晴，可谓“东边日出西边雨，道是无晴却有晴”。
examples.en: The evening's on-and-off rain was truly '东边日出西边雨，道是无晴却有晴'.

story.en: One of Liu Yuxi's 'Bamboo-branch songs', modelled on folk songs of Kuizhou, where a girl hears her beloved sing across the river.
story.zh: 刘禹锡仿夔州民歌所作《竹枝词》之一，写女子听到江上情郎歌声。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 千淘万漉虽辛苦，吹尽狂沙始到金
pinyin: qiān táo wàn lù suī xīn kǔ, chuī jìn kuáng shā shǐ dào jīn
literal: thousand · pan · ten-thousand · filter · though · toilsome, blow away · all · wild · sand · only then · reach · gold
natural: Though panning and filtering a thousand times is hard, only when the wild sand is blown away does the gold appear

meaning.en: Success comes after great effort and filtering out the false; quoted to encourage perseverance and discernment.
meaning.zh: 历经艰辛、淘尽杂质才能得到真金，常用来勉励人坚持，也说明真伪需经考验。

equivalents: to separate the gold from the sand

examples.zh: “千淘万漉虽辛苦，吹尽狂沙始到金”，科研就是要耐得住寂寞。
examples.en: '千淘万漉虽辛苦，吹尽狂沙始到金': research means enduring the loneliness.

examples.zh: 创业者把“千淘万漉虽辛苦，吹尽狂沙始到金”贴在办公室。
examples.en: The founders put '千淘万漉虽辛苦，吹尽狂沙始到金' up in their office.

story.en: One of nine 'Waves Wash the Sands' poems by Liu Yuxi, using gold-panning as a metaphor for perseverance.
story.zh: 刘禹锡《浪淘沙》九首之一，以淘金喻人生需历经磨砺。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 旧时王谢堂前燕，飞入寻常百姓家
pinyin: jiù shí wáng xiè táng qián yàn, fēi rù xún cháng bǎi xìng jiā
literal: former · times · Wang · Xie · hall · front · swallows, fly · into · ordinary · common · people's · homes
natural: The swallows that once nested before the halls of the Wang and Xie families now fly into the homes of ordinary people

meaning.en: The mighty families of the past have fallen, and the world changes; quoted for rise and fall in history and the transience of wealth.
meaning.zh: 昔日显赫的世家已经衰落，世事沧桑，常用来感叹兴衰更替、富贵无常。

equivalents: the grand houses of the past are now ordinary homes

examples.zh: 老宅现在成了民宿，真是“旧时王谢堂前燕，飞入寻常百姓家”。
examples.en: The mansion is now a guesthouse, truly '旧时王谢堂前燕，飞入寻常百姓家'.

examples.zh: 历史课上讲到“旧时王谢堂前燕，飞入寻常百姓家”，感慨沧桑。
examples.en: In history class, '旧时王谢堂前燕，飞入寻常百姓家' prompted reflections on the vicissitudes of time.

story.en: The Wang and Xie clans were the top aristocratic families of the Eastern Jin, living in Wuyi Lane in Nanjing; Liu Yuxi wrote of its decay centuries later.
story.zh: 王、谢为东晋最显赫的两大世族，居南京乌衣巷；刘禹锡于数百年后写其衰败。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 嘈嘈切切错杂弹，大珠小珠落玉盘
pinyin: cáo cáo qiè qiè cuò zá tán, dà zhū xiǎo zhū luò yù pán
literal: loud-rumbling · soft-murmuring · mingled · play, big · pearls · small · pearls · fall · jade · plate
natural: Loud notes and soft notes mingle, like big and small pearls falling on a jade plate

meaning.en: A famous simile for lively, crisp music; quoted to praise a fine musical performance.
meaning.zh: 形容琵琶声清脆悦耳、错落有致的名句，常用来赞美美妙的演奏。

equivalents: pearls falling on a jade plate

examples.zh: 听她弹古筝，真如“嘈嘈切切错杂弹，大珠小珠落玉盘”。
examples.en: Listening to her play the zither, it was truly '嘈嘈切切错杂弹，大珠小珠落玉盘'.

examples.zh: 乐评人用“嘈嘈切切错杂弹，大珠小珠落玉盘”形容这场演出。
examples.en: The critic used '嘈嘈切切错杂弹，大珠小珠落玉盘' to describe the performance.

story.en: From Bai Juyi's 'Song of the Pipa' (816), describing a former courtesan's playing that he heard on the Xunyang River.
story.zh: 出自白居易《琵琶行》（816年），写他在浔阳江头听琵琶女弹奏。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 几处早莺争暖树，谁家新燕啄春泥
pinyin: jǐ chù zǎo yīng zhēng nuǎn shù, shéi jiā xīn yàn zhuó chūn ní
literal: a few · places · early · orioles · vie for · warm · trees, whose · home · new · swallows · peck · spring · mud
natural: Here and there early orioles vie for sunlit trees; whose house do the new swallows seek with beaks full of spring mud?

meaning.en: Lively spring scene of birds at work; quoted for the busy vitality of early spring.
meaning.zh: 描写早春鸟儿忙碌的生机景象，常用来形容春天的活力。

examples.zh: 公园里“几处早莺争暖树，谁家新燕啄春泥”，一派生机。
examples.en: In the park '几处早莺争暖树，谁家新燕啄春泥', full of life.

examples.zh: 春天的作文常引用“几处早莺争暖树，谁家新燕啄春泥”。
examples.en: Spring essays often quote '几处早莺争暖树，谁家新燕啄春泥'.

story.en: From Bai Juyi's poem on a spring walk by West Lake (then called Qiantang Lake) in Hangzhou.
story.zh: 出自白居易写杭州西湖（钱塘湖）春行的诗。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 乱花渐欲迷人眼，浅草才能没马蹄
pinyin: luàn huā jiàn yù mí rén yǎn, qiǎn cǎo cái néng mò mǎ tí
literal: profuse · flowers · gradually · about to · dazzle · people's · eyes, short · grass · just · able · cover · horse · hooves
natural: Riotous flowers begin to dazzle the eye; short grass just covers the horses' hooves

meaning.en: A vivid picture of spring in full swing, with flowers and fresh grass; quoted for the dazzle of spring.
meaning.zh: 描写春光烂漫、繁花欲迷眼、浅草刚没马蹄的景象。

examples.zh: 踏青时只觉“乱花渐欲迷人眼，浅草才能没马蹄”。
examples.en: On a spring outing all I saw was '乱花渐欲迷人眼，浅草才能没马蹄'.

examples.zh: 摄影爱好者用“乱花渐欲迷人眼，浅草才能没马蹄”形容春天的西湖。
examples.en: The photographer used '乱花渐欲迷人眼，浅草才能没马蹄' for West Lake in spring.

story.en: The third couplet of the poem, describing the scenery along Hangzhou's Su Causeway in spring.
story.zh: 《钱塘湖春行》颈联，写杭州白堤一带春景。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉
pinyin: lǜ yǐ xīn pēi jiǔ, hóng ní xiǎo huǒ lú
literal: green · ants (wine bubbles) · new · brewed · wine, red · clay · small · fire · stove
natural: Newly brewed wine with its green froth; a little stove of red clay

meaning.en: A warm scene of an invitation to drink on a cold evening; quoted for cosy hospitality and friendly gatherings.
meaning.zh: 寒夜邀友饮酒的温馨场景，常用来形容待客的温暖与朋友小聚。

equivalents: a warm welcome on a cold night
new wine and a cosy stove

examples.zh: 下雪的晚上，朋友发来“绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉”。
examples.en: On a snowy evening a friend sent '绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉'.

examples.zh: 火锅店把“绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉”印在菜单上。
examples.en: The hotpot restaurant printed '绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉' on its menu.

story.en: Bai Juyi's quatrain inviting his friend Liu Shijiu to share a drink as the snow is about to fall.
story.zh: 白居易邀友人刘十九雪夜共饮的小诗。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 秋丛绕舍似陶家，遍绕篱边日渐斜
pinyin: qiū cóng rào shè sì táo jiā, biàn rào lí biān rì jiàn xié
literal: autumn · clumps · surround · house · like · Tao · home, all over · circle · fence · side · sun · gradually · slants
natural: Autumn chrysanthemum clumps surround my house like Tao Yuanming's home; I wander all around the hedge as the sun slants

meaning.en: Alludes to Tao Yuanming's love of chrysanthemums; quoted for a quiet life among autumn flowers.
meaning.zh: 化用陶渊明爱菊之典，常用来形容隐居、赏菊的闲适。

examples.zh: 小院里菊花盛开，宛如“秋丛绕舍似陶家，遍绕篱边日渐斜”。
examples.en: The courtyard chrysanthemums are in bloom, just like '秋丛绕舍似陶家，遍绕篱边日渐斜'.

examples.zh: 赏菊时他吟起“秋丛绕舍似陶家，遍绕篱边日渐斜”。
examples.en: Admiring chrysanthemums he recited '秋丛绕舍似陶家，遍绕篱边日渐斜'.

story.en: Yuan Zhen's poem on chrysanthemums, alluding to Tao Yuanming's line about picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence.
story.zh: 元稹咏菊诗，用陶渊明“采菊东篱下”之典。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 不是花中偏爱菊，此花开尽更无花
pinyin: bù shì huā zhōng piān ài jú, cǐ huā kāi jìn gèng wú huā
literal: not · is · among flowers · especially · love · chrysanthemum, this · flower · bloom · finish · no more · other · flower
natural: It is not that I especially love the chrysanthemum among flowers; it's that once it has bloomed, no other flower remains

meaning.en: A tribute to the chrysanthemum, the last flower of the year; quoted to praise resilience, or to say a choice is made for lack of alternatives.
meaning.zh: 咏菊为一年最后的花，常用来赞美坚毅的品格，或表示别无选择的偏爱。

equivalents: the last flower of the year

examples.zh: “不是花中偏爱菊，此花开尽更无花”，他对这份事业的执着源于此。
examples.en: '不是花中偏爱菊，此花开尽更无花': this explains his devotion to the career.

examples.zh: 深秋的菊展上有一句“不是花中偏爱菊，此花开尽更无花”。
examples.en: At the late-autumn chrysanthemum show there is a line '不是花中偏爱菊，此花开尽更无花'.

story.en: Closing lines of Yuan Zhen's 'Chrysanthemum', a poem often read as a quiet declaration of faithfulness.
story.zh: 元稹《菊花》的结尾二句。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。
